profile.name: HDAWG高密度任意波形发生器
profile.description: 这是一种高密度多通道任意波形发生器，可输出高速可编程波形，并通过触发、外部时钟和数字I/O与其他实验设备同步。它常用于量子控制实验、脉冲序列生成、时序联动和精密电子测量。
profile.description_en: This is a high-density multi-channel arbitrary waveform generator that produces high-speed programmable waveforms and synchronizes with other lab instruments through triggers, external clocks, and digital I/O. It is commonly used for quantum control experiments, pulse-sequence generation, timing coordination, and precision electronic measurements.
